_note: Model names per provider and tier, used by scripts/apply_models.mjs. Edit them to what your subscription or API account offers; the names here are the ones this repository's other examples and docs use. Tiers: strong = rare, costly-if-wrong (planning); balanced = bounded work from a plan (build, review); light = reading and running (readiness check, preflight, test strategy); alt = the finding verifier, which should not share a blind spot with the reviewer.
